title: perf-canary-auto-detect-sensitivity-hysteresis-rollout-guards
author: Priya Kannan
description: Motivation: reduce noisy perf canary flips while catching real latency/throughput regressions earlier. This PR tightens sensitivity for short-lived spikes, adds configurable hysteresis to avoid flip-flop during transient load, and improves signal aggregation across region/instance shards. Changes include: (1) adaptive windowing for detector thresholds based on recent P95/P99 variance; (2) hysteresis counters for promote/demote decisions; (3) cross-shard majority voting and weighted aggregation by request volume; (4) new config knobs exposed in perf-canary API and Console for thresholds, min-sample-size, and hysteresis windows; (5) additional unit and integration tests and simulation harness updates. Design notes: adaptive window uses exponentially-weighted variance estimate to scale threshold multipliers; hysteresis uses separate promote/demote counters with configurable timeouts to require sustained deviation before action. Rollout plan: staged rollout via canary config (10% -> 50% -> 100%) with automatic rollback on regression-blind failure cases; feature gated by runtime flag perf_canary.v2_enabled. Backwards compatibility: existing detector config still supported; new behavior controlled by config until fully validated. Impact: expected fewer false positives, slightly slower reaction to single-sample outliers but better stability for rollouts. See linked Linear tickets for evaluation plan and dashboard updates.
commit_summary: feat(perf-canary): adaptive window & hysteresis; refactor(detector): extract aggregation layer; test(sim): add spike/variance scenarios; docs: console knobs and migration notes; ci: add perf-sim job

testing_summary: Local unit tests added for adaptive-window and hysteresis state machine. Integration sim harness runs included: historical incident replay, synthetic high-variance workloads, and steady-state traffic. Perf-sim job ran on CI and compared baseline (v1) vs v2 over 72h synthetic runs: v2 reduced transient flip rate by ~78% and caught two sustained regressions earlier in weighted-aggregation scenarios. End-to-end test ensures config migration path and runtime flag gating.
release_notes: Improve perf canary stability: adaptive detection windows, hysteresis for promote/demote decisions, and cross-shard weighted aggregation to reduce false-positive rollouts. Expose new config knobs in Console. Backwards compatible and feature-flag gated.
rollback_plan: If rollout introduces missed regressions or service impact: disable perf_canary.v2_enabled via feature flag (instant), revert the helm chart values in infra/helm/perf-canary-values.yaml to previous stable commit (canary->single node), and roll back the Console change if required. Monitoring: immediate alert on missed-regression metric and increase in undetected-regressions window; manual A/B traffic split rollback if needed.
env_impact: no-db-schema-change; config-only changes and new helm values. Requires Console UI deploy to expose knobs. No infra instance type change.
notes: This PR consolidates several previous perf-canary fixes (see ENG-7423) and is intended to be the foundation for canary hysteresis and majority-vote policies in future follow-ups.
